messages.subject: Project Quartz — Licence mark-up (our redline)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our redline attached. The headline moves: (1) territory expanded to worldwide excluding the US, Canada and Mexico; (2) royalty reduced to 4.0%; (3) upfront reduced to £1.25m. We've left the liability cap for now but Klaus will want it tied to 12 months' fees. Most other changes are clarifications.

Adam

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
